item.summary: fix(infra): detect virtiofs and 9p filesystems to prevent WAL corruption (#120597) * fix(infra): detect virtiofs and 9p filesystems to prevent WAL corruption SQLite WAL requires shared-memory/mmap coherence between processes, which cross-VM filesystems (Docker Desktop, OrbStack, Podman host bind mounts) cannot provide. Under sustained write pressure the host<->VM cache can break silently, leaving zero-filled pages that corrupt the database. Add fuse.virtiofs, virtiofs, 9p, and 9p2000.L to the rollback journal policy so databases on these filesystems fall back to journal_mode=DELETE instead of the unsafe WAL mode. Closes #120549 * fix(infra): also detect virtiofs via Linux statfs magic number The CROSS_VM_FILESYSTEM_TYPES check handles virtiofs via mountinfo (/proc/self/mountinfo and macOS mount), but the statfs fallback in resolvePathJournalPolicy() had no entry for virtiofs. Add LINUX_VIRTIOFS_SUPER_MAGIC (0x6b656700) to the rollback-journal statfs check so virtiofs databases also get journal_mode=DELETE when the filesystem type is readable via statfs even if mountinfo parsing is unavailable. Extends the existing SMB/CIFS/SMB2/NFS statfs rollback test to include virtiofs. Closes #
